citations.text: This was a double-masked, randomized, single-center, vehicle-controlled, interventional clinical study (Clinicaltrials.gov identifier: NCT02874846).
The secondary efficacy endpoints as prespecified in the statistical analysis plan were:
Mean change from baseline in mean diurnal IOP (defined as the mean of the four diurnal time points: 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00 h) at day 8/day 9;
IOP was measured at each time point by study staff masked to treatment using a Perkins tonometer.
The secondary efficacy endpoints as prespecified in the statistical analysis plan were:
Mean change from baseline in mean diurnal IOP (defined as the mean of the four diurnal time points: 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00 h) at day 8/day 9;
Mean change from baseline IOP at each post-treatment time point at day 8/day 9;
Netarsudil significantly reduced IOP versus baseline at each assessed time point (Fig. 3a).
